newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunisia CPI up 3.9 pct in first ten months.
newsitem.headline: Tunisia CPI up 3.9 pct in first ten months.

text.p: Tunisia's consumer price index (CPI) rose 3.9 percent during the first ten months of 1996 compared with the same period in 1995, figures published by the National Institute of Statistics showed on Monday.
It rose 0.7 percent in October compared to a month earlier.
Details for the month/month change include food up 0.5 percent, leisure up 2.8 percent, clothing up 1.3, health up 0.7 percent, transportation flat and housing steady.
